description: Dept. of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources - Regulations made to amend the High Seas Fishing Operations Regulations No. 1 of 2014 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1878/12 of 01.09.2014
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, which constitutes legal/regulatory matters. It involves amendments to existing fishing regulations, compliance requirements, and technical specifications for fishing operations, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
